title: Cold Coffee
brief: Sarah is afraid of something she will not name. Marcus's fate surfaces. And the Records Annex you thought you knew becomes a trap with you inside.

threatEvents.event: Direct attack / trapped in the Records Annex (action gameplay).

howToExpand: Set startPhase to the first phase id.
Add phases: narrative | hub | location | dialogue | present | decision | courtroom | action | phone | epilogue.
Add evidence defs and dialogues. Effects/conditions DSL is documented in docs/ADDING_CASES.md.
End with an epilogue phase carrying outcomeReq (or outcome) and nextCase.
